terms.definition: Inspect, modify, commit, publish, and live-external actions are separate authorization phases for the current logical task. A completed, redirected, ambiguous, discussion-only, or analysis-only request does not authorize a later state-changing phase.
non_meanings: permission inherited from an earlier completed task
permission to commit or publish because modification was authorized

terms.definition: Use the target-registered canonical owner for a fact type, preserve its conflict resolver and synchronization direction, and treat routing records, summaries, evidence, frequency, and recency as non-authoritative unless that owner says otherwise.
terms.scope: fact lookup, decisions, changes, conflicts, and synchronization

terms.definition: A change that crosses a target-recorded protected category requires a current scoped approval whose semantic and path surfaces cover the actual change; changing the plan or scope invalidates approval as defined by the target policy.
terms.scope: protected architecture, business, data, security, dependency, permission, destructive, and live-external changes
non_meanings: general permission to modify the repository
approval reusable for a different task

terms.definition: Name changed semantic facts, re-derive their invariants, identify canonical owners and directly dependent surfaces, reconcile related findings as one repair set, validate the result, and report unresolved relationships and residual risk.
terms.scope: semantic changes, contradiction review, and material repair
non_meanings: reviewing only files named in a request
assuming structural validation proves domain correctness

terms.definition: Start from the smallest matching profile and selected index branch. Expand only for an applicable owner, safety or approval boundary, named dependency, changed-fact relationship, conflict, failed validation, or explicit broader audit, and record why the expansion occurred.
terms.scope: bootstrap, task routing, module overlays, and context receipts
non_meanings: omit required safety or owner evidence to remain under budget
load every related file before selecting a route
